note: 지난 토요일 시험의 정식 성적표는 성적 탭에서 확인.
routine: 복습 3분(영어 가리고 먼저 쓰기) → 가리고 써 보기 2분(빈칸 먼저, 맨 끝 정답 확인) → 새 내용 5분(노트에 옮길 때 짝 표현째로) → 소리 내어 3번 읽기 3분 → 오늘 쓸 표현 1개 골라 실제 메일에 쓰기

review.title: 복습 (10/26·10/23 표현 + 오답, 영어로 먼저 써 보기)

items.answer: This represents an increase of ~% compared with ~.

items.prompt: ~ 전에 왜 ~인지 알고 싶습니다 (패턴, why 뒤 평서문 어순)
items.answer: I'd like to understand why ~ before ~.

cover_practice.prompt: 수령: Please confirm r______ of the signed contract.
영향을 받은: How many workers were a_______ by the power cut?
예상되는: What is the e_______ arrival date of the fabric?
발견하다: The auditor did not o______ any fire exit issues.
전담의: We need a d________ person for GOH box loading.

words.meaning: 수령, 받음 — we received 대신 (발음: 리씨트, p 묵음)
words.example: Please confirm receipt of Mr [이름]'s passport copy.
Please let me know the final affected quantity of fabric.

words.meaning: 예상되는 — the date you will finish 대신
words.example: Please reply with the current status and the expected completion date.
words.collocations: expected completion date / expected arrival date

words.example: We did not observe any leaks after the roof repair.
words.collocations: observe an issue / no issues were observed

words.meaning: 전담의, 한 가지 일만 맡는 — fixed 대신
words.example: Please ask the supplier for a dedicated team for GOH box loading.
words.collocations: a dedicated team / a dedicated person

patterns.pattern: Please update us as soon as ~.
patterns.meaning: ~되는 대로 바로 알려 주세요 (Please let me know later 대신)
patterns.email: Please update me as soon as the flight is booked.
patterns.spoken: Let me know once it's booked.

patterns.meaning: ~까지 ~는 보류해 주세요 (Please do not ~ yet 대신)
patterns.email: Please hold off on rejecting the rate until the supplier sends a revised quotation.
patterns.spoken: Don't say no yet. Let's wait.

patterns.pattern: Just a reminder that ~ is due ~.
patterns.meaning: ~이 ~까지라는 점 다시 알려 드립니다 (I have not received ~ 대신, 덜 날카롭게)
patterns.skeleton: Just a reminder that + [주어] + is due + [날짜]
patterns.email: Just a reminder that the missing lot numbers are due by Oct 28 (Wed).

rewrite.original: I have not received your reply to the emails below. I attached all of them. Please reply to each item by tomorrow, Oct 27 (Tue). If the work itself needs more time, reply with the current status and the date you will finish.
rewrite.improved: I have not received your replies to the emails below (all attached). Please reply to each item by tomorrow, Oct 27 (Tue). If the work needs more time, please reply with the current status and your expected completion date.
rewrite.note: I attached all of them 한 문장 → (all attached) 괄호로: 짧아지고 핵심(답이 없다)이 앞에 선다. the date you will finish → your expected completion date: 업무 메일에서 굳어진 묶음 표현이라 상대가 답하기 쉽다. reply 앞에 please: 명령문이 연달아 날카로워지는 것을 막는다.

source: 10/26 보낸 메일(미회신 독촉, QR lot 번호 누락, GOH 박스 단가 보류, 방수포 견적, 라인밸런싱 수식), 받은 메일(원단 문제 수량, 접착 시험 결과, COC 수령 확인, 전담 적입팀 제안)
